title: [3.1.0.3] Dismissing Android Keyboard Closes Wizard Before Completion
symptom: On an S22 Ultra, after filling out the bolus wizard, the Android keyboard (SwiftKey) sits over the OK button on the confirmation screen. Dismissing the keyboard closes the wizard before you can hit OK. Also happens on carb/insulin entry screens.
cause: The issue seems to be an Android bug, as stated by Andries-Smit: 'This issue seems to be an Android bug. I tested it and could reproduce the issue.'
fix: Updating the phone to the latest Android patch (1 Dec 2022) resolved the issue for the maintainer, and the user confirmed it was fixed after receiving an OTA update, though it later recurred.
evidence_quote: This issue seems to be an Android bug. I tested it and could reproduce the issue. Now I updated to the latest version (patch 1 Dec 2022) and it does not seem to occur anymore.
